hero.heading: We build the software <accent>your business deserves.</accent>
hero.subheading: We build bespoke SaaS and automation platforms tailored to streamline your operations, save time, and dramatically boost your sales.

work.label: Portfolio
work.heading: Work that speaks for itself.
work.lead: Real systems, custom-built, running businesses every single day.

pos.label: Point of sale
pos.title: Infinito POS
pos.headline: The point of sale that runs the whole restaurant.
pos.body: Kitchen tickets, table management, and cash close in a single system. It replaced handwritten orders and spreadsheets in daily operations.

crm.label: CRM & sales
crm.title: KoiCRM
crm.headline: Every client, every conversation, in one place.
crm.body: A visual pipeline and automatic follow-up for teams that used to sell from WhatsApp and notebooks. Nothing slips, everything gets answered.

nutrea.label: Health & nutrition
nutrea.title: Nutrea
nutrea.headline: The nutrition practice, without the paperwork.
nutrea.body: Patient records, meal plans, and progress tracking in a single platform, designed alongside professionals in real consultations.

spa.label: Wellness
spa.title: SpaApp
spa.headline: Spa operations without friction.
spa.body: Scheduling by room and therapist, bookings, and the pulse of the day on a single screen. The front desk breathes and the team always knows what's next.

automations.label: Automation & AI
automations.heading: We connect the dots so your business runs on autopilot.

chatbots.title: Intelligent Chatbots
chatbots.body: Deploy 24/7 AI agents that handle customer inquiries, book appointments, and close sales seamlessly on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web.

omnichannel.title: Omnichannel Sync
omnichannel.body: Unify your communications. Connect WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram DMs into a single dashboard so no lead ever slips through.

funnels.title: Funnels & CRM
funnels.body: Automate your entire sales pipeline. From lead generation to nurturing sequences, we build precise workflows that convert visitors into loyal clients.

iximchat.title: IximChat
iximchat.headline: IximChat is live: WhatsApp AI for agriculture.
iximchat.body: An AI-powered digital assistant for agriculture and farming cooperatives. Record data, analyze crop trends, and make decisions directly from WhatsApp—no new apps required.

philosophy.quote: "Technology should empower the local community, not overwhelm it."
philosophy.heading: We are building for <red>our people.</red>
philosophy.p1: At Koi Software, we don't believe in generic, one-size-fits-all solutions. Our foundation is built on deep integration with local businesses and entrepreneurs.
philosophy.p2: You manage the people, we manage the data. By streamlining operations and opening powerful digital channels, we help you provide superior service to your clients.
philosophy.p3: When local businesses thrive, the whole community scales. That's why we build software that is accessible, beautiful, and relentlessly reliable.

services.heading: Beyond the platform.
services.subheading: Need something completely unique? Our custom consulting and development services bridge the gap between where you are and where you want to go.

accessories.title: Software Accessories
accessories.body: Custom bridges, webhooks, and add-ons built specifically for your existing software infrastructure.

optimization.title: System Optimization
optimization.body: We analyze your technical debt and workflows to dramatically speed up and secure your current operations.

tailored.title: Tailored Software
tailored.body: Zero compromises. Complete architectural design and implementation of bespoke software for distinct business models.

process.label: How we work
process.step1Body: We learn your operation in person, not through a form.
process.step2Body: We iterate with you on real software, not mockups.
process.step3Body: We stay close after launch, always.

cta.heading: Shall we build something great for your business?
cta.subheading: Tell us what you need and we'll come back with concrete ideas.

footer.tagline: Designed and built locally, for our people.
